p2.note: EN added an unmarked gloss "[death]" after Umm Qashʿam in the verse "الى حيث ألقت رحلها أم قشعم"; removed.
TR morphology of (معرضون) silently corrected source typo «حرب» (for «حرف»); added a marked translator note.
EN dropped the restriction of "إنما أنزلت فينا" in Abu Ayyub's report ("it was revealed concerning us"); corrected to "it was revealed only concerning us".

p1.note: Musaylima saying: Turkish had "yarin suda, yarin camurda" for نصفك (half of you) and both TR and EN added "kizi / daughter of" not in يا ضفدع يا ضفدعين; corrected.
Turkish Sarf (قثّاء): 'yerin kıssâsı (acurları) çoğaldı' garbled the gloss of كثر قثاؤها; changed to 'yerin hıyarları (acurları) çoğaldı'.
Arabic source itself breaks off at the end of the Fawaid (ends with دون); TR and EN reflect this with notes
TR (انفصام) "sondan bir önceki harften önce bir elif" wrong; Arabic قبل الأخير = before the last letter; fixed to "son harften önce"
Turkish silently supplied «تكفرون» as the amil where the source reads وهو العامل مضارع مرفوع (head dropped); added marked translator note.
TR silently dropped مثل in «ملك مثل من الملك» (now marked); EN footnote rendered the source «قول ربّك» as "remember when your Lord said (اذكر)", now translated as written.

p2.note: Arabic entry contains a duplicated block of the 2:29 i rab, clause analysis and morphology (from (اللام) ... متعلق ب (خلق) to (سوّاهنّ) فيه إعلال مثل استوى) inside the 2:30 analysis; both readings translate it as written with a marked note.

p1.note: EN said conjunctions "come after it" for Arabic تدخل عليها (enter upon it); reworded literally with translator note.

p2.note: EN morphology of (شية) silently corrected the source spelling «وشيء» to «وشي»; added a marked translator note.

p1.note: English clause note rendered فضربوها فحييت as 'so they struck him with it and he came to life'; changed to 'so they struck it and it came to life' (ها feminine, no 'with').

p2.note: EN footnote reversed the rule يغتفر في الثواني ما لا يغتفر في الأوائل as "what is tolerated in second elements is not tolerated in first ones"; corrected to "in second elements is tolerated what is not tolerated in first ones".

p1.note: English had an unmarked bracketed insertion '[and its genitive noun]' after (على الله) where Arabic has only «جارّ الفعل..»; replaced by a marked translator's note.

p2.note: Arabic source is garbled: after «(على الله) جارّ» the rest of the i rab, the clause analysis and the start of the morphology are missing, and it jumps to a hamza note («الفعل.. فهمزة الوصل ...»); both readings translate it as written with a marked note.

p1.note: Benefit 3 on «الناس» belongs to verse 8 (Turkish translator note says so). English: «ويعجزنا» was rendered 'we cannot deny' (not what the Arabic says); changed to 'baffles us' with a translator note, and added the verse-8 note.
EN Benefits item 4 silently rendered source وقبل التقاء الساكنين as "and the meeting of two quiescent letters", dropping "before"; restored with translator note as TR has
Benefits item on «يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ» belongs to verse 21 (Turkish translator note says so).
